# BB00537 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate

There is no power nor strength save in God, the Most High, the Most Great. O God, bestow blessings and peace and benediction. By the sanctuaries, I adjure you by the greatness of God's Essence, the Most High, and I beseech you by the holiness of God's attributes, O ye who are mentioned, that ye answer me and turn toward me and have mercy upon me and aid me and assist me and support me and strengthen me and honor me and help me and protect me and give me rest and deliver me.

Assist! Assist! Assist! Hasten! Hasten! Hasten! Answer! Answer! Answer! Answer! O God, I beseech Thee, O Succorer [ghayath], O Help in Peril [mustaghath], by the sanctity of Kaf-Ha-Ya-Ayn-Dad and Ha-Mim-Ayn-Sin-Qaf, and by the Mir'aj of the Chosen One, and by the martyrdom of the Accepted One, and by the nearness to Thee of the Companions of the Cave, and by the sanctity of Thy chosen ones before Thee.

And I beseech Thee by the choosing of Moses and his firmness in religion, and I beseech Thee by Thy Christ Jesus son of Mary and his modesty, and by the purity of Fatima the Radiant, and by the martyrdom of Husayn at Karbila, that Thou convey my greeting to Thy righteous servants and Thy wanderers in the earth, and urge them to aid me and help me against my enemies.

O Succorer! O Fulfiller! O Deliverer! O Liberator! O Savior! O Reliever! O Opener! O Comforter! O Friend! O Compassionate One! O Kind One! O Clement One! O my Lord! O my Master! Answer! And praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.
